description.value: Co-op Convenience Store is part of the Fort St. John Co-op, a locally-owned co-operative serving Fort St. John and Prespatou in northeastern BC's Peace River region. Affiliated with the broader Co-op network that also operates fuel cardlock, bulk propane, and a car wash in the area, this convenience stop is a practical resupply point for cyclists travelling through Fort St. John. The store accepts cash, debit, and credit cards and is air-conditioned.

address.value: 7315 100 Avenue, Fort St. John, BC V1J 5T8
